verses.gurmukhi: ਤੁਸ ਮੈ ਤੰਦੁਲ ਬੋਇ ਨਿਪਜੈ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਗੁਨੋ ਦੇਹ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਹੈ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: tus mai ta(n)dhul boi nipajai saha(n)sr guno dheh dhaar karat hai paraupakaar jee ||

en.bdb: A grain of rice covered by its husk when sowed yields many time more such grains and as rice (a staple food item) do much good in the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੁਸ ਮੈ ਤੰਦੁਲ ਨਿਰਬਿਘਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਨ ਘੁਨੁ ਰਾਖੇ ਰਹੈ ਚਿਰੰਕਾਲ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: tus mai ta(n)dhul nirabighan laagai na ghun raakhe rahai chira(n)kaal hot na bikaar jee ||

en.bdb: The rice remains protected against insects as long as it remains in the husk. It remains preserved for long.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੁਸ ਮੈ ਨਿਕਸਿ ਹੋਇ ਭਗਨ ਮਲੀਨ ਰੂਪ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਕਰਵਾਇ ਰਾਧੇ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: tus mai nikas hoi bhagan maleen roop savaiaadh karavai raadhe rahai na sa(n)saar jee ||

en.bdb: Outside the husk, rice breaks. It acquires a darkish hue and slight bitterness. It loses its worldly importance.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਤਜਿ ਬਨਖੰਡ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਉਧਾਰ ਜੀ ॥੧੨੧॥
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes gursikh gireh mai bairaagee gireh taj banakha(n)dd hot na udhaar jee ||121||

en.bdb: So does a Sikh of Guru following the advice of Guru lives a householder's life without being attached and engrossed in it. He does good to others while living with his family members. He does not renounce the family and lives in jungles to emancipate himself from this world. (121)
